verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser publishes its own API reference section, with endpoint pages such as 'fetch-a-web-page', and its docs include code snippets. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in the browser, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request execution in the API reference, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Fetches a web page and returns the content in various formats (HTML, Markdown, JSON, screenshot, etc.)
